---
title: "Phylogenetic covariance matrix"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(ape)
library(here)
```

Compute `A` for the union of all tips that appear in any analysis, exactly
as in `10_external.Rmd`. Save as a flat CSV for exploration in Python.

```{r compute}
tip_map <- read.csv(here("data", "preprocessed", "tip_map.csv"))
tips    <- unique(na.omit(tip_map$tip_name))

tree        <- read.tree(here("data", "jaeger2018", "world.tre"))
tree_pruned <- keep.tip(tree, tips)
A           <- vcv.phylo(tree_pruned, corr = TRUE)

write.csv(A, here("data", "preprocessed", "phylo_corr.csv"))
cat("Saved", nrow(A), "×", ncol(A), "correlation matrix\n")
```

Quick sanity check on a few pairs.

```{r sanity}
pairs <- list(
  c("IE.GERMANIC.ENGLISH", "IE.GERMANIC.DANISH"),
  c("IE.GERMANIC.ENGLISH", "IE.GERMANIC.GOTHIC"),
  c("IE.GERMANIC.ENGLISH", "IE.ROMANCE.LATIN"),
  c("IE.GERMANIC.ENGLISH", "IE.ROMANCE.FRENCH"),
  c("IE.GERMANIC.ENGLISH", "IE.INDIC.SANSKRIT"),
  c("IE.GERMANIC.ENGLISH", "AA.SEMITIC.ARABIC_QURANIC"),
  c("IE.GERMANIC.ENGLISH", "Kor.KOREAN.KOREAN")
)

for (p in pairs) {
  cat(sprintf("%-30s vs %-30s  %.4f\n", p[1], p[2], A[p[1], p[2]]))
}
```
